question: An online retailer uses 200 cloud-hosted virtual machines (VMs). Currently, the configuration of each VM is performed manually. To support the growth strategy of the retailer, the retailer starts to automatically scale the VMs to meet demand and uses Ansible for configuration management. Which action must be performed in Ansible to meet the requirements before automation is performed?
options: Add each VM to the .ini inventory file.
Set up and configure Ansible Tower.
theory: A static .ini inventory file, or manually registering each VM, can't keep pace with a fleet of VMs that scales automatically up and down; Ansible's dynamic inventory plugins instead query the cloud provider's API at run time to build the current host list on the fly, so newly created VMs are automatically included and terminated ones drop out without any manual inventory editing. Ansible Tower/AWX is optional surrounding tooling, not a prerequisite for using dynamic inventory itself. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 17 — Evaluate Automation and Orchestration Technologies) / (Cisco documentation / web research)
